steps.question: Does this call use the Wrangler CLI (a `wrangler` command or `npx wrangler`) to manage, develop, or deploy Cloudflare resources or Workers, where the cf CLI or a Cloudflare MCP tool can do it directly? Answer no when the call already uses cf or a Cloudflare MCP tool, and no for live logs (`wrangler tail`) and single secrets (`wrangler secret put`), which cf does not yet support.

then.text: Chauffeur: Prefer the cf CLI or a Cloudflare MCP tool over Wrangler for Cloudflare work; cf covers the public Cloudflare API and Workers projects (see https://developers.cloudflare.com/cf/). Keep Wrangler only for live logs (`wrangler tail`) and single secrets, which cf does not yet support.
